subject: Quick Save item
text: The GBC, smartphone and Switch versions removed the Quick Save item because their hardware has Quick Save built in.

subject: quick save monster
text: In the later versions the monster that used to drop the Quick Save item drops a special helmet that reduces the MP cost to cast spells.

evidence.quote: The monster that used to drop it now drops the special helmet that reduces the MP cost to cast spells.

subject: Spell targets
text: 1E means one enemy, 1G one group of enemies, All E all enemies, and travel and field spells are also listed.

subject: Experience
text: Each party member can max out at 1,000,000 experience points in every version.

evidence.quote: Each member of your party can max out at 1,000,000 experience points, no matter which version of the game you're playing; however, there are different level caps.

subject: Level cap
text: The level cap is 50 for each party member in the iOS/Android/Switch version, and 50, 45 and 35 for Midenhall, Cannock and Moonbrooke in all other versions.
